meta.title: CaptionFitter - Every line, just right.
meta.description: An app that aligns your transcript to the voice in a video and turns it into subtitles. Works for spoken word and songs, entirely on your device.

hero.title: Every line, just right.
hero.subtitle: CaptionFitter aligns your transcript to the speech in a video and turns it into subtitles. It works for spoken word and songs, and everything stays on your device.
hero.requirements: Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon.

open.title: Open a video
open.body: Drop in a video or audio file to get started.

transcript.title: Set up the transcript
transcript.body: Paste the text you already have, transcribe automatically, or search for a song and apply its lyrics automatically.

align.title: Align and export
align.body: Review and fix anything that needs it, then export an SRT subtitle file or a video with subtitles.

features.title: Everything you need to finish the subtitles

sources.title: Transcript sources
sources.body: Paste a transcript, transcribe automatically when you have none, or search for a song on LRCLIB and apply its lyrics.

editor.title: Preview and subtitle editor
editor.body: Edit text, adjust timing, split and merge subtitles, and shift everything at once.

review.title: See what needs review
review.body: Lines that may be off are marked so you know what to watch for before you export.

style.title: Subtitle style
style.body: Set the font, size, colors, shadow, position, and more to design how your subtitles look.

export.title: SRT subtitle file or video with subtitles
export.body: Export a subtitle file, a new video with the subtitles burned in, or both.

models.title: On-device speech models
models.body: Download the speech model that suits your device and process everything with its own computing power.

privacy.title: Your data never leaves your device
privacy.body: Alignment and export run entirely on your device, and your video and transcript are never uploaded. CaptionFitter only needs an internet connection to download speech models and when you search lyrics.

footer.made: CaptionFitter is an app built with SwiftUI and WhisperKit.
